summary_en: This Phase II study tests inavolisib plus ribociclib and fulvestrant against placebo plus ribociclib and fulvestrant in advanced HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer. The drugs are given on the schedule set in the protocol, and the exact schedule and duration are not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase II and evaluates efficacy and safety.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II compara inavolisib más ribociclib y fulvestrant con placebo más ribociclib y fulvestrant en cáncer de mama avanzado con receptores hormonales positivos y HER2 negativo. Los medicamentos se administran según el esquema indicado en el protocolo; el esquema exacto y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase II y evalúa la eficacia y la seguridad.
who_for: Women or men with locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer that cannot be cured with surgery or radiation.
Estrogen and/or progesterone receptor-positive tumor, with at least 1% of tumor cells positive.
No prior systemic treatment for advanced breast cancer; progressed during adjuvant endocrine therapy or within 12 months after finishing it.
Tumor has no PIK3CA mutation and has heterozygous loss of chromosome 8p, confirmed by central lab testing.
Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1.
not_for: Appropriate for cytotoxic chemotherapy at study entry, such as those with visceral crisis.
Type 1 diabetes at any time, or type 2 diabetes needing ongoing systemic treatment at entry.
Untreated or active brain metastases, or any history of leptomeningeal disease or carcinomatous meningitis.
